title: Quenched Tunisian Grain Tagine
description: A comforting, mustardy tagine featuring wholegrain mustard, served over wholegrain couscous. This dish is a great choice for a sick day, as it is easy to digest and can be made with minimal preparation time.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a clay pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken thigh and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the wholegrain mustard, couscous, chicken broth, and water to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the fresh parsley and lemon juice.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
